query:
INSERT INTO sessions (
            user_id,
            device_id,
            family_id,
            stage,
            mfa_verified_at,
            access_hash,
            access_expires_at,
            refresh_hash,
            refresh_expires_at,
            idle_expires_at
        )
        SELECT
            user_id,
            device_id,
            family_id,
            2,
            mfa_verified_at,
            $3,
            now() + interval '10 minutes',
            $4,
            refresh_expires_at,
            now() + interval '24 hours'
        FROM sessions
        WHERE id = $1::text::uuid
          AND user_id = $2::text::uuid
        RETURNING id::text AS "id!"
